'''Matt Hanson ELOM beatdown''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Matt Hanson]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-9984">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9984 ELOM beatdown], DeckTech (Matt "Sledder" Hanson, 29 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9984/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9984/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018125717/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9984/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Published:''' 29 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ELOM beatdown''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]

== Original post ==

'''ELOM beatdown'''
* '''Author:''' Matt "Sledder" Hanson
* '''Published:''' August 29, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' elom's with docking bay activation

=== Strategy ===

if you are playing space set up drain's at the db's as fast as u can while trying to take out the ships in space, if playing ground set up drain's in space while u fight the characters on the table and takeover some good drain sites
